title: Back To The Negotiating Table
summary: Would more Iranian crude exports help the tanker market? OPEC+ has announced that it will gradually increase production from May through July of this year, potentially adding more than 2 million barrels per day (Mb/d) of crude to the market over this period. In theory, this should be good for the tanker market, because this oil will have to be moved somewhere.
